deadline_text_verbatim: The standard deadline for applications is 13 January 2027 18:00 (UK time), but if you are applying for Medicine or Dentistry then the deadline is 15 October 2026 18:00 (UK time).
limitations: KCL's page also notes a UCAS cap: applicants may submit a maximum of five courses per year, but only four of those may be Medicine/Dentistry courses - recorded here as context, not as a separate deadline.
researcher_notes: Live browser re-check 2026-09-01. KCL's own how-to-apply page states this cleanly and unambiguously for the current 2027-entry cycle - the clearest of the sources checked this pass.
